description:
List available categories (domains and AI tags) in the Spark marketplace.

For when domain filter values or taxonomy are needed; search_assets returns
assets rather than categories. Takes no parameters. Returns Markdown lists
of AI tag names/slugs and domain names/slugs grouped by parent category;
domain slugs are accepted by search_assets' domain filter. AI tags are not a
search_assets filter. Public catalog lookup, no login or download recorded.

For example, list_categories().
name: list_categories
title: List categories
